info.title: Al Qarib Corporate Banking — Sandbox API
info.description: Sandbox API of the Al Qarib corporate banking MVP. Bank core and payment rails are deterministic SIMULATIONS with synthetic data; nothing here reaches a real bank, rail or card system. Every write needs an Idempotency-Key. Money is exchanged as `{ currency, minor }` with `minor` an integer string.
